title: House Takes Up Massie’s Impeachment Articles Against Hegseth
dek: Rep. Thomas Massie’s resolution accuses Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth of waging the Iran war without authorization; a procedural House vote was set for Tuesday, with a possible final vote Wednesday.
author: Meridian Newsroom
keyPoints: Rep. Thomas Massie, a Kentucky Republican, read eight articles of impeachment against Hegseth on the House floor on Monday.
Most counts focus on the Iran war, including three alleging hostilities without authorization under the War Powers Resolution, per NPR.
A procedural House vote was set for Tuesday; a final vote could come Wednesday, per AP.
Hegseth called the effort “sabotage” at his first Pentagon news conference in six months.
body:
Rep. Thomas Massie, a Kentucky Republican who lost his primary to a Trump-backed challenger and leaves Congress in January, read articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on the House floor on Monday, the first day of sessions after the midterms, [AP News](https://apnews.com/article/hegseth-pentagon-briefing-congress-impeachment-f5303cfb626ae2ef7a4a3f660f5519df) reported.

## What the articles say

[NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/09/nx-s1-6034483/thomas-massie-impeachment-pete-hegseth) reported that the resolution lists eight charges. Three allege unlawful war with Iran under the War Powers Resolution. Others cover a failure to minimize civilian casualties, strikes on alleged drug boats in the Caribbean and Eastern Pacific, the capture of Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro without congressional authorization, and military action against Yemen. Massie told the House that Hegseth “knowingly executed and implemented unlawful orders.” Hegseth has called the effort a “sham.”

## The procedural vote

The House was set to vote Tuesday on whether to advance the effort. The vote would either block the resolution or set up a final vote Wednesday, [AP News](https://apnews.com/article/hegseth-impeachment-briefing-trump-massie-87a78193502f716e6fb8eee5aef06ac0) reported. House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries supports the measure, so Massie would need only a few Republican votes if most Democrats follow him. The [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwr5y58jjp8ro) reported that the effort will likely fail because Republicans remain in control of Congress until January.

## Hegseth’s defense

In his first Pentagon news conference in six months, Hegseth said: “This is not patriotism. This is sabotage.” He called Massie a “disgruntled, defeated congressman,” according to the BBC. Trump praised the briefing on social media, and Vice President JD Vance called the effort “a ridiculous show,” AP reported. If the House approves the articles, the matter would go to the Senate for a trial, per NPR and the NYT.

## What happens next

AP reported that the House procedural vote would either block the impeachment resolution or set up a final vote Wednesday. The BBC reported that the resolution starts a 48-hour clock for the chamber to take it up. Lawmakers could vote on it directly, refer it to committee, or set it aside. The BBC also reported that the effort will likely fail, since Republicans remain in control of Congress until January; Massie has said the aim is to push President Donald Trump to replace Hegseth before Democrats can launch their own impeachment process.

Trump lashed out at Massie personally, calling him a “loser” who “has a lot of hatred in his heart,” AP reported. Vice President JD Vance called the effort “a ridiculous show that stands in for actual policymaking” in a post on social media. Massie is leaving Congress in January after losing his primary.
